Needs changes before merge.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `06d349391ca27e193a943fb37c51380e2c283f95` has a code conflict. I aborted the trial merge. The results below apply to the PR head alone. They do not certify the combined tree.

**Requested before merge**

1. `crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs:447`: The `Warning::UndercutLift` display arm conflicts with main's `Warning::AvoidHit` arm. Keep both arms during the merge-time refresh. Follow the stated stack order for #2714. Run the required checks on the combined tree.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/undercut_page.rs:13`: The diff adds the undercut page and changes the cutter editor. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add both views to the body. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit review images to the PR branch.
3. `crates/motion/src/sinker_undersize/outline.rs:77`: The PR has no results for the reached heavy lanes. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, under **Heavy lanes at review**, requires them on the final head. The motion and app changes reach those lanes. The body says that ignored heavy tests were not exercised. This head's gate tool also reports `unknown tier 'heavy'`. After the required refresh, run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. Name the lanes and their results in the body. A quick-gate pass does not satisfy this requirement.

**Local results**

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 780 steps. It took 64.8 minutes.

| Crate | Steps, including build | Tests passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| tools | 5 | 123 | 0 | 0 |
| sim | 72 | 679 | 0 | 3 |
| motion | 111 | 1279 | 0 | 58 |
| app | 574 | 3985 | 0 | 43 |
| ui | 18 | 1386 | 0 | 9 |

Each crate passed its selected `cargo test --no-run` build. UI tests ran from `crates/ui`. The UI library passed 1258 tests, with 7 ignored. Ignored tests are not recorded as passes. No snapshot PNG was changed.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Named safety coverage passed:

- `motion/sinker_outline`: 10 tests.
- `motion/golden_undercut`: 4 tests.
- `sim/undercut_laws`: 14 tests.
- `app/mcp_slot_undercut`: 7 tests.
- `app/sinker_cavity_outline`: 1 test.
- `app/sinker_electrode_body`: 7 tests, including the diamond finish and project round-trip.
- All three new undercut UI behavior tests and both tool-default tests passed.

**Extra suites run**

The added golden files have one reader: `crates/motion/tests/golden_undercut.rs`. I ran `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test golden_undercut` again: 4 passed.

I also ran the readers of the changed shared EDM helper:

- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test sinker_burn`: 15 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test sinker_burn_held`: 7 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wire_post`: 12 passed.

No model fixture or import implementation changed. The extra kernel STEP suites do not apply.

**Independent mutations**

I ran both mutations in the disposable review worktree. I restored the original source after each mutation. The tracked tree is clean.

| Mutation | Pin | Guard removed | Source restored |
|---|---|---|---|
| containment | `matching_extents_do_not_hide_an_oversized_electrode_outline` | RED, 1 failed | GREEN, 1 passed |
| finish-coverage | `a_finish_that_leaves_a_wall_undersize_is_refused` | RED, 1 failed | GREEN, 1 passed |

The expected mutation failures were:

```text
the rectangle crosses the walls: 0.02
the electrode is too small: 0.02
```

**Golden inspection**

I checked every line of the four added CL goldens against the generator and their test parameters:

- `slot_undercut_tslot_straight.cl`: centre pass, 2 mm and 3 mm widenings, then return to the entry station.
- `slot_undercut_dovetail_straight.cl`: centre pass, 2 mm widening, then return to the entry station.
- `slot_undercut_keyseat_arc.cl`: arc centres, directions, 2 mm offsets and tangent entry agree with the stated parameters.
- `slot_undercut_lollipop_arc.cl`: the opposite arc direction and 2 mm offsets agree with the ball's contact radius.

Every lateral cutting move stays at Z = -12 mm. Every Z move stays at the entry station. No NC golden changes in the PR diff.

The outline validation, optional project key, MCP schema and operation stamp have useful pins. The separate stock verdict still checks the actual burn.

Heavy lanes were not run in this review. The release gate and a real EDM control were not exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
